changes.summary: Document the projects.acceptance.updated history event in the business history matrix.

Projects: one universal acceptance form. Documents are created, edited and deleted in a drawer built on DrawerHeader/DrawerBody/DrawerFooter (44px close, sticky footer, confirmed delete, MoneyInput amounts), a signing day signs a document, and a protocol kind joins act and delivery note. Applications plug in through the AcceptanceKinds, AcceptanceCurrencyPolicy and AcceptanceSaveHook interfaces. Adds project_acceptance_documents.signed_on, opens the kind column to application kinds, and Repository.Update/Document.Revise; the inline form of the acceptance tab is replaced by the drawer.
